ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Irregular low-intensity mottling and clusters distributed across the interior high-intensity (white) regions, featuring high-density vertical streaks on the left lobe and more dispersed circular spots on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 82 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary with varying pixel-amplitudes, presenting as a jagged saw-tooth profile with several larger, non-uniform indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the superior boundary of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark, sub-circular pixel groupings visible on the inner right lobe and near the outer margins of the left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) observed primarily on the medial and lateral sections of the left lobe, cutting vertically through the high-intensity background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, non-symmetrical notches on the trailing edge of the left lobe suggesting historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical 'fork-like' pigmentation marks originating from the central-left fluke surface.
